SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-04: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — ViewDefinition.select.column.collection, ViewDefinition.select.column.type, ViewDefinition.select.column.tag. Test these items: collection default false when unset, error when multiple values are produced for a non-collection column, collection true multi-value output representation, type URI handling for primitive and non-primitive result expectations, type mismatch reporting for generated/executed columns, tag 0..* parsing with required tag.name and tag.value, database/implementation type-hint tags do not affect base semantics unless explicitly handled. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
